arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. We've asked the landlord whether they agree to you fitting your own machine (which you would own and take with you) or would rather deal with it themselves. If you can, please send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 29 July.

arguments.decision_needed: Tenant reports the LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has failed and says it cannot be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement at their own cost, which would remain their property and be removed when they leave. Is the existing machine yours (included in the tenancy)? arguments.body: Thanks for letting us know about the washing machine, and for offering to replace it. Because the machine was in the flat when you moved in, we need the landlord's consent before anything changes, so please don't dispose of it or buy a replacement just yet. We've asked the landlord whether they agree to you fitting your own machine (which you would own and take with you) or would rather deal with it themselves. If you can, please send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 29 July.
